case.title: Midnight Masquerade Murder
case.introduction: A glittering charity gala is underway at Villa Aurora. The elite mingle under chandeliers, unaware that a deadly secret lurks behind the masks.
case.crime: At 9:10 PM, the philanthropist host, Gregory Hart, is found dead in the private study, a decorative letter‑opener driven into his back.
case.escape_plan: The murderer slips through a concealed door behind the library bookshelf, leading to an underground tunnel that exits near the garden fountain.

rooms.name: Grand Hall
rooms.description: A lavish ballroom with crystal chandeliers, where the gala takes place.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A quiet library‑styled room with a mahogany desk, where the victim was found.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: Moonlit terraces and a fountain, connected to a hidden service tunnel.

characters.name: Sophia Delacroix
characters.background: Arrived in town a month ago, claiming to represent a European gallery.
characters.secret: Is actually Victor Kline, a disgraced former business partner of the victim seeking revenge.
characters.goal: Exact revenge on Gregory Hart and vanish without a trace.
characters.alibi: Was mingling in the Grand Hall, chatting with guests, until 9:00 PM when she stepped away to the balcony for fresh air.

relationships.detail: Discussed security arrangements before the gala.

knowledge: The study contains a hidden door
lies: She never saw the victim after the performance
She was not near the balcony at 9:00 PM

characters.name: Ethan Hart
characters.background: Worked for Gregory for five years, knows his schedule intimately.
characters.secret: Owes a small debt to a loan shark, but kept it hidden.
characters.goal: Protect Gregory's reputation and secure his own promotion.
characters.alibi: Was in the Grand Hall serving drinks until 9:05 PM, then went to the kitchen to restock.

relationships.detail: Reports to Carlos for security matters.

knowledge: The letter‑opener is part of the decorative set on the desk
The study's window was locked from inside
lies: He saw Sophia enter the study after 9:10 PM

characters.name: Maya Liu
characters.background: International violinist invited to perform at the gala.
characters.secret: Had a public dispute with Gregory over a contested charity fund donation.
characters.goal: Deliver a flawless performance and restore her reputation.
characters.alibi: On stage in the Grand Hall from 8:45 PM to 9:05 PM, then returned to the Green Room.

relationships.detail: Briefly chatted about art after the performance.
Ethan handed her water during the set.
Carlos escorted her to the stage.

knowledge: A shattered champagne glass with her fingerprint was found near the study
She noticed a hidden door while walking backstage
lies: She never entered the study that night

characters.name: Carlos Mendoza
characters.background: Veteran security chief hired to oversee the gala’s safety.
characters.secret: Harbors an unrequited love for Gregory, which clouds his judgment.
characters.goal: Ensure the event runs without incident and keep Gregory safe.
characters.alibi: Patrolled the perimeter from 8:30 PM to 9:15 PM, checking cameras and doors.

relationships.detail: Discussed security protocols before the event.
Ethan reports to him on logistics.
Ensured Maya’s safe passage to the stage.

knowledge: The security camera in the hallway malfunctioned briefly at 9:08 PM
The garden tunnel exit is concealed behind a hedge.
lies: He was in the hallway at 9:10 PM when the murder occurred

timeline.description: Guests arrive, masks and champagne are served in the Grand Hall.
Maya Liu begins her violin performance on the stage.
Sophia steps onto the balcony for fresh air; Carlos continues his patrol; Ethan returns to the kitchen.
Security camera in the hallway glitches; a faint sound is heard near the study.
A scream echoes; Gregory Hart is found dead in the Study.
Police are called; guests are confined to the Grand Hall while investigation begins.
Detective discovers a torn cufflink and a blood‑stained letter‑opener near the body.

evidence.name: Torn Silver Cufflink
evidence.description: A cufflink matching the set Gregory always wore, torn in half and found under the study desk.

evidence.name: Blood‑Stained Letter‑Opener
evidence.description: The decorative letter‑opener, identical to one in Sophia's clutch, covered in the victim's blood.

evidence.name: Shattered Champagne Glass
evidence.description: A glass broken near the hallway, bearing Maya's fingerprints.

evidence.name: Security Camera Glitch Log
evidence.description: Log shows the hallway camera offline for 12 seconds at 9:08 PM.

hidden_clues: Gregory's diary entry dated two weeks ago mentions a betrayal by 'V.K.'
A hidden latch behind the library bookshelf reveals a tunnel leading to the garden.
Sophia's clutch contains a duplicate of the decorative letter‑opener.
red_herrings: Maya's broken glass suggests she may have been near the murder scene.
Carlos's patrol route places him near the hallway during the camera glitch.

solution.reasoning: The torn cufflink (e1) and the blood‑stained letter‑opener (e2) both match items owned by Sophia, yet her alibi places her on the balcony at the time of the murder. The hidden tunnel behind the bookshelf (revealed in hidden clues) provides a means for her to slip from the balcony to the study unnoticed. Gregory's diary mentions 'V.K.', the initials of Victor Kline, confirming the motive of revenge. All other evidence either points to innocent guests or serves as red herrings.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
